_doc: GAMES-GRAPHICS §4 frame-time gate (tests/frametime.spec.ts). Tablet project (1180x820, pixel ratio 2), CPU slowed down by the CDP rate below, 10 s of play on Μονοκέρια per variant. 'reference' = /?e2e&keeplook&gfx=base (the look before GAMES-GRAPHICS), 'candidate' = /?e2e&keeplook (the default «Κανονικά»). Both run in the same test on the same machine, interleaved in segments of 2.5 s (ref, cand, cand, ref, ...), so the relative gate does not depend on which CI machine runs it.
absoluteGate: only when the reference itself meets p95MaxMs on this machine; otherwise only the relative gate (candidate p95 <= reference p95 x (1 + maxGrowth))

baseline._doc: The «before» numbers of PR 1 (no GAMES-GRAPHICS change yet), recorded for the record; the gate itself uses the reference measured in the same run.

local.machine: owner PC (Windows, other jobs running), 2026-11-02, two runs
